lessons.title: Talking about Pain
lessons.tip: In German, the verb comes second in the sentence. For example, in 'Ich habe Kopfschmerzen', 'Ich' is the subject, 'habe' is the verb, and 'Kopfschmerzen' is the object.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you also have stomach pain?

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who is concerned about your health
scenario.learnerRole: a person who is feeling unwell
scenario.brief: Your friend asks about your health. Tell them where it hurts and respond to their suggestions.

lessons.title: At the Pharmacy

items.example: Ich brauche eine Tablette gegen Kopfschmerzen.
items.exampleMeaning: I need a tablet for headaches.
I am going to the doctor.

lessons.tip: When asking for something at the pharmacy, use 'Ich hätte gerne...' to make it polite. For example, 'Ich hätte gerne die Tabletten.' means 'I would like the tablets.'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I am going to the pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dann kannst du die Tabletten nehmen.
dialogue.meaning: Then you can take the tablets.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who is helping you
scenario.brief: Your friend is asking what you need at the pharmacy. Tell them what you need and if you have a prescription.
scenario.goal: You should communicate your needs clearly.

lessons.title: Giving Advice
lessons.tip: Use the imperative form to give advice. For example, 'Trink viel Wasser' is a command meaning 'Drink a lot of water.'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Trink viel Wasser und schlaf genug.
dialogue.meaning: Drink a lot of water and sleep enough.

scenario.brief: Your friend asks how you feel and gives you advice. Respond to their questions and suggestions.
scenario.goal: You should express your feelings and respond to advice.

lessons.title: Feeling Better
lessons.tip: When talking about improvement, use 'Ich fühle mich...' to express how you feel. For instance, 'Ich fühle mich besser' means 'I feel better.'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have a doctor's appointment?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have a doctor's appointment.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Das ist gut. Gesundheit ist wichtig.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend checking on your health
scenario.brief: Your friend asks how you are feeling and if you have seen a doctor. Respond positively and discuss health.
scenario.goal: You should show improvement in your health and discuss your plans.

review.title: Review of Health and the Doctor

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Trink viel Wasser und entspanne dich.
dialogue.meaning: Drink a lot of water and relax.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend checking on your health
scenario.brief: Your friend asks about your health and gives advice. Discuss your symptoms and plans for recovery.
scenario.goal: You should express your symptoms and show improvement.
